subject: Live evidence is 3 days old — please re-mint mac-run.json
body: artifacts/live-evidence/mac-run.json was last committed 2026-09-20T11:40:55-04:00 (3.0 days as of 2026-09-23T16:24Z), past the 3-day threshold, and no refresh request was outstanding.
